name: cloud-swarm
description: SWARM-CLOUD — multi-human, multi-agent coordination cloud service (authority core). Forked from swarm (local CLI) to keep the in-use local tool stable.

scripts.build:command-core: esbuild src/protocol/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --external:node:crypto --banner:js='// GENERATED from src/protocol/index.ts; do not hand-edit.' --outfile=supabase/functions/_shared/protocol.js
scripts.check:edge: deno check --config supabase/functions/command/deno.json supabase/functions/command/index.ts supabase/functions/read/index.ts supabase/functions/capability/index.ts
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/protocol-next.test.ts tests/protocol-workspace.test.ts tests/protocol-agent-token-binding.test.ts tests/support/cold-start-retry.test.ts tests/p1-cli/test-gate-coverage.test.ts
